feedback.problem:
Let $c=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 8 \\ -1\end{aligned}]$ and $d=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].$ Find the vector projection of $c$ onto $d.$

${\text{proj}}_{d}\,c=⟨$  

{{field-1}},

{{field-2}},

{{field-3}}

$⟩$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{d}\,c & =\frac{c\cdot d}{d\cdot d}d \\  & =\frac{{c}_{x}{d}_{x}+{c}_{y}{d}_{y}+{c}_{z}{d}_{z}}{{d}_{x}^{2}+{d}_{y}^{2}+{d}_{z}^{2}}d \\  & =\frac{(-2)\cdot (-1)+8\cdot 3+(-1)\cdot (-2)}{(-1)^{2}+{3}^{2}+(-2)^{2}}d \\  & =\frac{28}{14}⟨-1,3,-2⟩ \\  & =2⟨-1,3,-2⟩ \\  & =⟨-2,6,-4⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
